purpose: Safely resume interrupted property investigations from the last verified state without repeating valid completed work or treating partial work as completed.
core_principle: RECOVER VERIFIED STATE → IDENTIFY OPEN DEPENDENCIES → RESUME FROM THE EARLIEST UNRESOLVED MATERIAL STAGE.
resume_rules: Completed stages with unchanged dependencies may be reused.
Completed stages with materially changed dependencies must be reverified before downstream reuse.
In-progress stages are never treated as completed merely because an event exists showing that work started.
Failed retrieval is not evidence of record absence.
A blocked stage resumes only when its blocking dependency is resolved or new valid evidence/input exists.
A run may resume from an earlier stage if a downstream dependency has become invalid.
Current and historical scope must be reconstructed separately.
hard_stops: Never resume from an unverified partial state as though it were complete.
Never discard prior events to simplify recovery.
Never assume an interruption means the last stage succeeded.
Never reuse stale evidence merely because it was previously retrieved.
Never silently broaden or change property/date scope during recovery.
If the event chain cannot support reliable reconstruction, block rather than invent state.
